Name: Hot Chocolate Coffee Alternative
Author: certifiableGrimalkin
Description:
[font=Courier New][size=3]Source: [url=https://github.com/certifiableGrimalkin/HCCA]https://github.com/certifiableGrimalkin/HCCA[/url].
If anyone wants to work on this for their own sake, feel free to.

This mod intends to give you an alternative to using all of the coffee related items, in the game.[/size]
[size=3]It introduces Cocoa Beans, Hot Chocolate, Hot Chocolate Goo and a Hot Cocoa Ring, to supplement or replace, respectively, Coffee Beans, Coffee, Triple-Shot Espresso and the Hot Java Ring.[/size]

[size=3]The only reason for this is, that I personally don't like coffee, but didn't want to hamper my gaming experience, by not drinking it.[/size]

[b][size=5]How to Obtain the items.[/size]
[size=3]Cocoa Beans[/size][/b]
[size=3][spoiler]
Sold by Krobus for 35 G. Sold by the Travelling Merchant, at 2500 G. 1% chance to be dropped by Dust Sprites.
[/spoiler]
[b]Hot Chocolate[/b]
[spoiler]
Sold by Gus for 400 G. Five Cocoa Beans put in a Keg will make Hot Chocolate, after two in-game hours.
[/spoiler]
[b]Hot Chocolate Goo[/b]
[spoiler]
Drink Sold by Gus for 1200 G, from Fall 1, Year 2, during every Fall and Winter. Recipe given by Gus through letter, on that same day.
After buying the recipe, they are cooked, using three Hot Chocolates to make one Goo.
[/spoiler]
[b]Hot Cocoa Ring[/b]
[spoiler]
Once you reach the Mr. Qi Wallnut Room on Ginger Island, you will receive a mail, with the recipe, not long after.
It takes:
1 Prismatic Shard
5 Iridium Bars
999 Hot Chocolate Goo
[/spoiler]

[/size]
[size=5][b]Effects
[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Hot Chocolate[/b]
[spoiler]
Gives +1 Speed and +1 Luck, for about 125 seconds.
[/spoiler]
[b]Hot Chocolate Goo[/b]
[spoiler]
Gives +1 Speed and +1 Luck, for about 500 seconds
[/spoiler]
[b]Hot Cocoa Ring[/b]
[spoiler]
Any monsters spawned by the game, while the player is wearing the ring, have a 25% chance to drop Hot Chocolate, and a 7.5% chance to drop Hot Chocolate Goo.
[/spoiler][/size]


[size=3]Cocoa Beans grow in Spring and in Summer, take 10 days to grow at first, and then regrow every two days, similarly to Coffee beans.[/size]

There is a bug, where the after getting the recipe for the Hot Chocolate Goo, you don't see the recipe in your cooking tab. It's visible in the cooking menyu, though. Not sure what causes it.

This mod has been inspired by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8354]Cocoa Plant and Chocolate Cooking (JA)[/url], by eorrl. I really enjoyed it, but it didn't quite give me the complete alternative to coffee I was looking for, so I decided to play around with making something of my own.
